faqs.question: When is the Mersing Half Marathon Powered by JomRun® held?
faqs.answer: The Mersing Half Marathon Powered by JomRun® is scheduled to take place on October 18, 2026. The event will be held at Dataran Air Papan, located in Mersing, Johor, Malaysia, giving runners a specific date to plan their travel and training around this upcoming race.
